description: Config is the flux-mirror configuration file.

artifacts.description: Artifacts lists OCI artifacts to mirror.

items.description: ArtifactEntry mirrors an OCI artifact (image, OCI chart, signed manifest, etc.).

destination.description:
Destination is where the artifact is mirrored to. For DestinationType
"oci" it is an OCI repository. For "artifactory" it is the directory URL
of a Helm repository (scheme optional, https by default); the chart file
name (<name>-<version>.tgz) is appended automatically.

destinationType.description:
DestinationType selects the kind of destination. "artifactory" requires
the source to be an OCI Helm chart and publishes the chart .tgz to a JFrog
Artifactory Helm repository. Defaults to "oci".

hooks.description: Hooks configures checks that run before an artifact is copied.

pre.description: Pre lists checks to run before a tag is copied.

concurrency.description:
Concurrency caps the number of work units executing this step at once. A
work unit is one verification or scan task: a tag for cosign, one tag and
platform for wizcli. Defaults to 1.

cosign.description: Cosign configures keyless cosign verification for this step.

index.description:
Index verifies the digest the tag points at: the image index of a
multi-arch image, or the image itself for a single-platform tag.

attestations.description:
Attestations lists the attestations that must be attached to the digest
and signed by one of MatchOIDCIdentity, each as a short alias (spdx,
slsa-provenance, cyclonedx) or a full predicate type URI. They are read
from the cosign tag-based .att tag of the verified digest.

matchOIDCIdentity.description: MatchOIDCIdentity lists the Fulcio certificate identities to accept.

items.description: OIDCIdentity matches a Fulcio certificate identity.

issuer.description: Issuer is the OIDC issuer URL of the signing identity.

subject.description: Subject is a regexp matched against the certificate subject.

minAge.description: MinAge requires a signature to be at least this old before mirroring.

platform.description:
Platform verifies the platform manifests listed in it, each as its own
work unit.

attestations.description:
Attestations lists the attestations that must be attached to the digest
and signed by one of MatchOIDCIdentity, each as a short alias (spdx,
slsa-provenance, cyclonedx) or a full predicate type URI. They are read
from the cosign tag-based .att tag of the verified digest.

matchOIDCIdentity.description: MatchOIDCIdentity lists the Fulcio certificate identities to accept.

items.description: OIDCIdentity matches a Fulcio certificate identity.

issuer.description: Issuer is the OIDC issuer URL of the signing identity.

subject.description: Subject is a regexp matched against the certificate subject.

minAge.description: MinAge requires a signature to be at least this old before mirroring.

platforms.description:
Platforms lists the platforms to verify, each as os/arch or os/arch/variant
(for example linux/amd64). Every platform is its own work unit, and a
platform missing from the image index is an error.

name.description: Name is a unique identifier for this step within the artifact entry.

onDeny.description:
OnDeny controls what a policy denial does: "block" stops the tag, which
is reported as blocked, and "warn" records the denial and lets the tag
continue to the next step and the copy. Defaults to "block".

onError.description:
OnError controls what an exhausted infrastructure error does (a timeout,
a crashed tool, an unreachable registry): "block" fails the tag and
"warn" records the error and lets the tag continue. A policy denial is
not an error; see OnDeny. Defaults to "block".

retries.description:
Retries is the number of extra attempts after an infrastructure error.
Defaults to 0.

timeout.description:
Timeout is the total time allowed for this step, including retries.
Defaults to the sync --timeout.

wizcli.description: Wizcli configures Wiz CLI scans for this step.

binary.description: Binary is the wizcli executable. Defaults to wizcli, resolved on PATH.

platforms.description:
Platforms lists the platforms to scan, each as os/arch or os/arch/variant
(for example linux/amd64). Every platform is scanned as its own work unit;
the tag passes only when all of them pass. A platform missing from the
source image index is an error.

policies.description:
Policies lists the Wiz policies to apply. When omitted, wizcli evaluates
every policy of the account that applies to CLI scans.

ignoreDriftForExitCode.description:
IgnoreDriftForExitCode still reports and logs drifted tags, but excludes
them from the drift exit code. When every drifted tag belongs to an entry
with this field set, the run does not exit with the --drift-exit-code
value.

includeReferrers.description: IncludeReferrers also mirrors the artifact's referrers (signatures, SBOMs).

overwrite.description: Overwrite re-mirrors tags that already exist at the destination.

selector.description: Selector selects which tags to mirror.

limit.description: Limit caps how many tags are mirrored. 0 means unlimited.

regex.description: Regex applies a Go regexp prefilter to tags.

extract.description: Extract is the named capture group used as the sort/semver value.

pattern.description: Pattern is the Go regexp applied to tags.

semver.description: Semver is a semver constraint applied after the regex prefilter.

sortBy.description: SortBy selects the sort strategy: semver, alphabetical, or numerical.

source.description: Source is the OCI repository the artifact is mirrored from.

verify.description: Verify configures signature verification for source artifacts.

matchOIDCIdentity.description: MatchOIDCIdentity lists the Fulcio certificate identities to accept.

items.description: OIDCIdentity matches a Fulcio certificate identity.

issuer.description: Issuer is the OIDC issuer URL of the signing identity.

subject.description: Subject is a regexp matched against the certificate subject.

minAge.description: MinAge requires a signature to be at least this old before mirroring.

charts.description:
Charts lists Helm charts to mirror from an HTTP/S repository into an OCI
registry. Mirroring a chart that already lives in an OCI registry is an
OCI-to-OCI copy; configure it under Artifacts instead.

items.description:
ChartEntry mirrors a Helm chart from an HTTP/S repository to an OCI
registry or to a JFrog Artifactory Helm repository. To mirror a chart that is
already in an OCI registry, use an ArtifactEntry instead (an OCI Helm chart is
mirrored as a plain OCI artifact).

destination.description:
Destination is where the chart is mirrored to. For DestinationType "oci"
it is an OCI repository (the oci:// prefix is optional) and the chart name
is appended. For "artifactory" it is the directory URL of a Helm repository
(scheme optional, https by default); the chart name is not appended and the
file name (<name>-<version>.tgz) is added automatically.

destinationType.description:
DestinationType selects the kind of destination: "oci" publishes the chart
as an OCI Helm chart, "artifactory" uploads the chart .tgz to a JFrog
Artifactory Helm repository. Defaults to "oci".

ignoreDriftForExitCode.description:
IgnoreDriftForExitCode still reports and logs drifted versions, but
excludes them from the drift exit code. When every drifted version
belongs to an entry with this field set, the run does not exit with the
--drift-exit-code value.

overwrite.description: Overwrite re-mirrors versions that already exist at the destination.

selector.description:
Selector selects which chart versions to mirror. It is the same selector
as ArtifactEntry.Selector: regex → semver → sort → top-N, applied to the
version strings listed in the repository index (for example
"1.2.3+build.5", not the OCI tag form "1.2.3_build.5"). Without semver no
semver filter applies, so prereleases are included.

limit.description: Limit caps how many tags are mirrored. 0 means unlimited.

regex.description: Regex applies a Go regexp prefilter to tags.

extract.description: Extract is the named capture group used as the sort/semver value.

pattern.description: Pattern is the Go regexp applied to tags.

semver.description: Semver is a semver constraint applied after the regex prefilter.

sortBy.description: SortBy selects the sort strategy: semver, alphabetical, or numerical.

source.description: Source is the HTTP/S repository URL the chart is mirrored from.

hosts.description:
Hosts configures per-host authentication for OCI registry requests, both
source pulls and destination pushes.

items.description:
RegistryHost binds an authentication method to a registry host. Credential and
Provider configure the HTTP-layer registry credential. A cloud Provider (ecr,
acr, or gar) accepts a Credential whose identity is exchanged for the cloud
provider's access credential instead of using the ambient cloud identity. On a
cloud provider host the credential source may be Provider (github, forgejo, or
spiffe only), Value, FromPath, JWKPath, or JWKValue; Username and Envelope are
rejected, as are the gcp, azure, and aws credential providers. TLS configures
the transport-layer TLS/mTLS settings: it composes with Credential and with the
default (generic) Provider, but is mutually exclusive with a cloud Provider — a
cloud registry provider is a managed registry whose transport flux-mirror does
not customize. At least one of Credential, a cloud Provider, TLS, or
MaxChunkSize must be set.

acr.description:
ACR configures Azure ACR authentication when this host uses the acr
provider together with a credential.

clientID.description: ClientID is the Microsoft Entra application (client) ID.

tenantID.description: TenantID is the Microsoft Entra tenant ID.

credential.description:
Credential configures the HTTP-layer registry credential for the host. A
cloud Provider host accepts Value, FromPath, JWKPath, JWKValue, or a
github, forgejo, or spiffe Provider; see RegistryCredential.

audiences.description:
Audiences is the audience claim. Defaults to Host, or to the cloud
provider's federation audience on a cloud Provider host.

envelope.description:
Envelope transforms the resolved credential before it is sent to the
registry. It is a Go template whose data is a single Token field holding
the credential, with two functions available: base64 (standard base64)
and hex (lowercase hexadecimal). For example, "token-{{ hex .Token }}"
sends the hex-encoded credential with a token- prefix. An unset envelope
sends the credential unchanged. It is only valid on a generic Provider
host.

expiration.description: Expiration is the jwkPath/jwkValue JWT lifetime. Defaults to 60s.

fromPath.description: FromPath sends a static JWT read from the file at the path.

issuer.description: Issuer is the issuer claim for jwkPath/jwkValue-signed tokens.

jwkPath.description: JWKPath signs a fresh JWT with the private JSON Web Key at the path.

jwkValue.description: JWKValue signs a fresh JWT with the private JSON Web Key read from the config.

provider.description:
Provider mints a per-request credential for the audiences, one of
JWTProviderGitHub, JWTProviderForgejo, JWTProviderGCP, JWTProviderAzure,
JWTProviderAWS, or JWTProviderSPIFFE. On a cloud provider host (ecr, acr,
gar) the credential identity is exchanged with the cloud provider, so only
JWTProviderGitHub, JWTProviderForgejo, and JWTProviderSPIFFE are accepted
there.

subject.description: Subject is the subject claim for jwkPath/jwkValue-signed tokens.

type.description:
Type is the kind of credential material (CredentialTypeJWT). Defaults to
jwt; other types (such as x509) are reserved for a future release.

username.description:
Username presents the credential as the password of a username/password
pair. When unset, the credential is used as a bearer token. It is only
valid on a generic Provider host.

value.description: Value sends a static JWT read from the config.

direction.description:
Direction limits the host entry to source pulls or destination pushes.
It defaults to both, and lets the same host carry different credentials
for each side of a mirror.

ecr.description:
ECR configures Amazon ECR authentication when this host uses the ecr
provider together with a credential.

roleARN.description:
RoleARN is the IAM role assumed with the credential identity via
AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity.

stsEndpoint.description: STSEndpoint overrides the AWS STS endpoint used for the role exchange.

gar.description:
GAR configures Google Artifact Registry authentication when this host
uses the gar provider together with a credential. Without a credential,
the provider uses the ambient Google identity instead.

gcpServiceAccount.description: GCPServiceAccount is the optional service account to impersonate.

workloadIdentityProvider.description:
WorkloadIdentityProvider is the full resource name of the workload
identity pool provider.

host.description: Host is the registry host (and optional port) the auth applies to.

maxChunkSize.description:
MaxChunkSize is the maximum size in KiB (1024 bytes) for an OCI blob
upload PATCH to this host; larger blobs are split into chunked PATCH
uploads. 0 (the default) disables chunking, sending a single monolithic
PATCH per blob. Useful for registries or proxies that cap request bodies.

provider.description:
Provider selects a cloud registry provider's workload-identity credentials
for the host: RegistryProviderECR, RegistryProviderACR, or
RegistryProviderGAR. Omitted (or RegistryProviderGeneric) means an ordinary
registry, for which flux-mirror configures the credential and/or TLS
directly. A cloud provider is mutually exclusive with TLS, but accepts a
Credential to source the identity exchanged with the cloud provider. That
credential must come from Value, FromPath, JWKPath, JWKValue, or a github,
forgejo, or spiffe Provider; see RegistryCredential.

tls.description:
TLS configures transport-layer TLS for the host: a PEM directory or inline
PEM fields (custom CA and/or client certificate), or SPIFFE mutual TLS.

ca.crt.description:
CACert is the PEM-encoded CA bundle used to verify the registry's server
certificate. It is the inline counterpart of ca.crt in Path.

path.description:
Path is a directory of PEM files, laid out like a mounted Flux
certSecretRef: ca.crt verifies the registry's server certificate and/or
tls.crt with tls.key presents a client certificate for mTLS. At least one
of ca.crt or the tls.crt/tls.key pair must be present.

spiffe.description: SPIFFE configures SPIFFE mutual TLS for the host.

serverIDs.description:
ServerIDs authorizes the registry's X.509-SVID. Each entry accepts the
RFC-0014 forms parsed by the Flux crypto API: an exact SPIFFE ID, a SPIFFE
trust domain, a SPIFFE ID prefix ending in "/", or the "spiffe://self"
forms for the client's own trust domain.

tls.crt.description:
TLSCert is the PEM-encoded client certificate chain. It is the inline
counterpart of tls.crt in Path and must be set with TLSKey.

tls.key.description:
TLSKey is the PEM-encoded client private key. It is the inline
counterpart of tls.key in Path and must be set with TLSCert.

title: Config is the flux-mirror configuration file.
